dedupe_keys.name: smartmeter energy consumption data in london households low carbon london

description: This London Datastore dataset holds half-hourly electricity consumption readings for 5,567 London households that took part in the Low Carbon London project led by UK Power Networks between November 2011 and February 2014, recruited as a balanced sample representative of Greater London. Each row gives the household identifier, date and time and kWh per half hour; the full CSV is about 10 GB unzipped with around 167 million rows, also offered as 168 files of one million rows. About 1,100 households were on a dynamic time-of-use tariff throughout 2013, receiving high (67.20p/kWh), low (3.99p/kWh) or normal (11.76p/kWh) price signals a day ahead by in-home display or text message, and the signal schedule is included; the others were on a flat 14.228p/kWh tariff. Coverage: London, 2011 to 2014. Access: zipped CSV downloads and a tariff file. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution; free. Caveats: data are anonymised, carry few household attributes, and were last updated years ago. Simulation uses are household load profiles, price response and demand flexibility studies, and distribution network planning. Related records: the UK Energy Demand Research Project smart meter trials and the IDEAL household energy dataset.
